description: Create or repair the business_links entries used by the send_link/send_sms tools. These entries let callers receive booking, directions, cancellation, sister-location, or service-specific links by text without raw URLs in the voice prompt.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

dry_run.description: Validate and show create/update plan without writing.

links.description: Links to create/update by link_key. New links require label and destination_url. Existing links can be deactivated with is_active=false.

destination_url.description: HTTPS destination URL. kaicalls.com destinations are rejected.

is_active.description: Whether this link can be sent.

link_key.description: Snake_case key the agent/tool uses, e.g. recovery_directions.

name: configure_textable_links
title: Configure Textable Links
